{{Quote|Well, look at you. I think you might be just what I'm looking for. Do not be alarmed, this is a simple spell of Mindspeech.|[[Rubina]], talking to an adventurer|<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
'''Mindspeech''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] wielded by the [[Witches of Dathomir]]. The witch [[Rubina]] used this power to project her image and voice into the head of a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to guide the adventurer and give advice.
